record.original_question: Let X be a compact Riemann surface of genus g ≥ 2, let SU_X(r) be the moduli space of semistable rank-r vector bundles on X with trivial determinant, let L be the determinant line bundle on SU_X(r), and let Theorem 5 denote the Verlinde formula for dim H^0(SU_X(r), L^k). Is there a direct proof of that theorem, for example one obtained by applying Riemann–Roch after computing the relevant Chern numbers of the moduli space?

evidence.quote: The simplicity of the formula itself suggests the following question:
Q 5. – Can one find a direct proof of thm. 5 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a compact Riemann surface of genus g ≥ 2, and let SU_X(r) denote the moduli space of semistable rank-r holomorphic vector bundles on X with trivial determinant. Let L be the determinant line bundle on SU_X(r) (the ample generator of the Picard group). For a positive integer k, the Verlinde formula gives an explicit closed expression

  dim H^0(SU_X(r), L^k) = (r/(r+k))^g · Σ_{S ⊔ T = {1,…,r+k}, |S|=r} ∏_{s∈S, t∈T} |2 sin(π(s−t)/(r+k))|^{g−1}.

Provide a direct algebro-geometric proof of this formula by computing the Chern numbers of SU_X(r) (or of a suitable desingularization or modular cover) and applying the Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch theorem to L^k on SU_X(r).
artifact.category_tag: Verlinde formula and moduli of vector bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The Verlinde formula now has several direct algebro-geometric/intersection-theoretic proofs. Jeffrey and Kirwan (Annals of Math., 1998) computed intersection pairings on the moduli space of rank-n bundles of fixed determinant on a Riemann surface and used them, via Riemann–Roch, to give a direct proof of the Verlinde formula. Further proofs along these lines have been given by Meinrenken, Bismut–Labourie, and others, including a finite-dimensional proof published in Science China Mathematics (2021).

status_evidence.title: Intersection theory on moduli spaces of holomorphic bundles of arbitrary rank on a Riemann surface
status_evidence.snippet: Jeffrey and Kirwan used formulas for intersection numbers on M(n,d) to obtain a proof of the Verlinde formula for dim H^0 of a line bundle over M(n,d).
status_evidence.claim: A direct proof via intersection theory / Riemann–Roch on the moduli space exists.

status_evidence.title: A finite dimensional proof of the Verlinde formula
status_evidence.snippet: Finite dimensional proof of the Verlinde formula.
status_evidence.claim: Additional direct algebro-geometric proofs of the Verlinde formula have been published.
